name: 记忆管家
tagline: Mirrors each bot's setup and memory into a private Git repo you control
description: A bot's configuration and everything it has learned sit inside the account, with no obvious way to get them back once something breaks. This one copies both out to a private repository on a fixed folder layout, keeps a register of what it holds, and revisits the set to catch gaps. A whole fleet can be rebuilt from it.
author: AYi_AInotes
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
